correctness.rationale: The addition theorem yields the exact normalized degree-l output Gram. Root coordinates constrain all off-diagonal angles to pi/2, pi/3, pi/4 and yield H_(l+24)=H_l+24 I, with PSD of all bases ensuring positive shift for l>=24. A standalone exact-integer checker reproduces every one of 24 base characteristic polynomials from 24 integer power sums via Newton identities. Degrees, multiplicities, normalizations, odd-degree rational similarity, and two tight residues were reconstructed; no infinite claim is inferred from finite experiments.
